slides.title: What residents say
slides.body: Explosions at night, shops shut, more federal forces nearby (Addis Standard).

slides.title: Control of the town is unclear
slides.body: ACLED, Nov 13: neither side controlled Badme. Diplomats' claims not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via Anadolu (UA.NEWS), ACLED (Nov 14, 2026)
